'''Axial Park South''', also known as the '''South Tram Station''', was a tram station on the [[Coronet Junction]], the public transport system of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], located in the southern part of [[Axial Park]].<ref name="Coronet Junction TOR" />
